messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: Prod HTTP 5xx spike on embeddings gateway (us-west-2). Affected: saffron-corp (enterprise dedicated + hosted). Paging @tim-oncall. Tags: #paging #customer-impact
alex: i'm on it, adding @priya @sara-cs. brief: we see cache timeouts from kv-backend after a model rollout ~12:30 UTC.
priya: confirmed — rollout caused async cache miss storm. starting immediate rollback of model v2.3 -> v2.2
zach-eng: rollback command executed: ```sh
./deploy rollback --model saffron-embed:v2.3 --to v2.2
``` monitor logs shows worker reconnects
tim-oncall: i'm taking oncall. please prep customer comms for Saffron: tailored impact + contact routing. assigning @maya-liaison to coordinate with Saffron AM.
sara-cs: drafting now. Need precise affected window and feature name. Are embeddings for search-only or also for recommendations?
alex: affected window ~12:34–12:51 UTC. Impact: 'Semantic Search & Document Similarity' degraded (partial failures and increased latency). Recommendations engine unaffected.
maya-liaison: confirmed Saffron primary contacts via account sheet:
- Taylor Lane (devops) taylor.lane@saffron.com
- Amanda Nguyen (platform lead) amanda.nguyen@saffron.com
- Ryan Chen (account manager) ryan.chen@saffron.com
sara-cs: Draft customer-facing blurb — please review:
```
Status: Degraded Embeddings (Saffron account)
Summary: Between 12:34–12:51 UTC we observed elevated 5xx errors affecting embeddings for Saffron's 'Semantic Search' feature. Root cause: cache saturation during a model rollout; we rolled back the rollout at 12:36 UTC.
Impact: Some embedding requests returned errors or experienced higher latency. No customer data was exposed. We mitigated by rolling back the model; error rates returned to baseline by 12:51 UTC.
Next steps: Engineering will perform a controlled rollout with throttled cache warm-up; we will share a post-incident analysis within 24 hours.
If you need immediate support, contact your AM Ryan Chen (ryan.chen@saffron.com) or devops (taylor.lane@saffron.com).
```
priya: rollback confirmed finished at 12:36:42 UTC. error rate down to normal p95. monitoring for residual 503s.
alex: ok to post to status page and send tailored email. i'll publish the status update: ```
[saffron] 12:34 UTC — Degraded embeddings (resolved 12:51 UTC). See incident id #7923456789.
```
tim-oncall: posting status page now, @sara-cs please queue the tailored email and cc AM. i'm changing rota to standby until 13:15 UTC. :thumbsup:
sara-cs: queued email and sent notify to Taylor + AM. cc list: ops@redwood-inference.com
maya-liaison: Saffron replied: "thanks for quick action, please share RCA." I'll request post-incident RCA and set expectation for 24h.
zach-eng: adding follow-up tasks to the incident board: cache warm-up policy, rollout gating for embeddings. assigning to @zach-eng and @priya.
incident-bot: Incident #7923456789 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Timeline updated. Pager duty note attached.
